additional_info.subject: RE: ID0484161-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP/S7170003960] Charging issue CRM:03056001117
additional_info.body:
Hi Catalin,
SPIE was on site today, and I supported them remotely.
Apparently, one port on the external switch did not show an active connection, even though the cable was plugged in.
SPIE replaced the cable, and everything is now working properly again.
I will close the ticket.
Kind regards,
Johannes
